name: e-delta
caption: An impressionist oil painting, loose visible broken brushstrokes, thick impasto dabs of pure color, soft atmospheric light, simple bold composition that stays readable when shrunk to a tiny phone thumbnail. (photo:-2) (3d:-2) (vector:-2) (anatomy:-2) An aerial view of a river delta at sunset painted impressionistically: many thin golden-red tributaries branch across dark green-violet land and all converge into one glowing round red-orange lagoon at center-right, like blood vessels feeding a tumor.
